frozen_criterion.AB_BA: Same ingredients, inventory, loads and v0; prepared ordering/routing differs. Do not call equal scalar outputs equivalent functional structure.
frozen_criterion.learning: Opposite/omitted/unpaired histories under identical interfaces are controls.
frozen_criterion.not_claimed: Abstract order inference, ANTES/DESPUES generality or learned interpersonal roles.
frozen_criterion.primary: Use both experience-created directional states in sequence; compare exact vector and load, then equal environmental contact.
frozen_criterion.retention: Independently exposed backups receive one common query after a quiet interval; extra exposures are counted.

geometry.acquired: Directional mobile states generated by admitted cue/report collisions; no prepared trained RAW
geometry.designed: Order/routing, teaching opportunities, two equal environment inputs and backup interfaces
geometry.roles: A and B are investigator component identifiers, not acquired pronouns or temporal concepts
geometry.scope: Ordered physical composition. No claim of abstract ANTES, participant identity inference, or free grammar.
